req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-035 requires that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) return application/json content type. Tests must verify: (1) positive — each endpoint returns exactly 'application/json' in Content-Type with HTTP 200; (2) negative — wrong HTTP methods return 405 (not 200, not JSON); (3) boundary — Content-Type header value starts with exactly 'application/json' and not a superset/subset string. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 vs 405), exact content-type strings, and exact JSON structure keys present in the response body.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data

tests.name: test_post_returns_application_json_content_type
expected: Response body contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.post('/post', data=json.dumps({'key': 'value'}),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.content_type
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in data

tests.name: test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html
actions: Check Content-Type is NOT empty string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_is_exactly_application_json_not_text_html():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.content_type
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/html')
    assert not ct.startswith('text/plain')
    assert ct != ''
    assert 'application/json' in ct

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type
actions: Send correct HTTP method to each of /get /post /put /patch /delete
expected: All five endpoints return Content-Type starting with application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} returned {r.status_code}"
        ct = r.content_type
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f"{method} {path} content-type was {ct}"
        data = r.get_json()
        assert data is not None, f"{method} {path} body was not valid JSON"

No extra keys, no missing keys
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_response_body_keys_exact_set():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    actual_keys = set(data.keys())
    assert actual_keys == expected_keys

tests.name: test_get_with_query_params_still_returns_json
actions: Assert args dict contains foo and baz
trace: R-HTTPBIN-035 -> /get with query params -> application/json preserved
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_with_query_params_still_returns_json():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.content_type
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert data['args']['foo'] == 'bar'
    assert data['args']['baz'] == '1'
